children.label: Blood Potency for this generation
children.formula: if(generation >= 14, 0, if(generation >= 10, 1, if(generation >= 8, 2, if(generation >= 6, 3, if(generation >= 5, 4, 5))))) & "–" & if(generation >= 14, 0, if(generation >= 12, 3, if(generation >= 10, 4, if(generation >= 9, 5, if(generation >= 8, 6, if(generation >= 7, 7, if(generation >= 6, 8, if(generation >= 5, 9, 10))))))))

visibleWhen.formula: or(blood-potency < if(generation >= 14, 0, if(generation >= 10, 1, if(generation >= 8, 2, if(generation >= 6, 3, if(generation >= 5, 4, 5))))), blood-potency > if(generation >= 14, 0, if(generation >= 12, 3, if(generation >= 10, 4, if(generation >= 9, 5, if(generation >= 8, 6, if(generation >= 7, 7, if(generation >= 6, 8, if(generation >= 5, 9, 10)))))))))

children.label: Feeding
children.formula: if(blood-potency >= 10, "Animal and bagged blood slake no Hunger; human blood slakes 3 less Hunger; only a kill brings Hunger below 3", if(blood-potency >= 9, "Animal and bagged blood slake no Hunger; human blood slakes 2 less Hunger; only a kill brings Hunger below 3", if(blood-potency >= 7, "Animal and bagged blood slake no Hunger; human blood slakes 2 less Hunger; only a kill brings Hunger below 2", if(blood-potency >= 5, "Animal and bagged blood slake no Hunger; human blood slakes 1 less Hunger; only a kill brings Hunger below 2", if(blood-potency >= 4, "Animal and bagged blood slake no Hunger; human blood slakes 1 less Hunger", if(blood-potency >= 3, "Animal and bagged blood slake no Hunger", if(blood-potency >= 2, "Animal and bagged blood slake half Hunger", "No penalty")))))))
